summary: Car-dealer display lot packed with stock; no room, and a van would stand out.
reasons: Lot full of dealership stock cars
Busy, lit commercial frontage on Moggill Road
No free space seen for a van

drivers.seclusion: Open commercial forecourt beside a major junction, overlooked by showrooms and staff; no cover.
drivers.access_and_room: Lot is open to Moggill Road but every bay holds stock cars; no spare room seen. A mapped gate has a way round.
drivers.traffic: Arterial and junction on two sides, constant noise; Moggill Road clearway beside the lot.
drivers.convention: Cars here are dealer stock and customer parking, not overnight parking; a van left overnight would be noticed.

flags: Dealer lot, mapped customers-only parking nearby
sun_shade: Open tarmac, full sun; some trees shade the Moggill Road edge from the west.
cannot_judge: Whether the lot is gated or patrolled after hours
